attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3048/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The line enumerates six men by name, so there is a folder for each, and the six share one life. The display name takes the day: the corpus keeps `isaacius-companion-of-alexandra` on the Greek 21 April. No `dates` object is proposed, because the page's heading gives this name no year and its narrative dates only the stoning. The page notes that in the Paris Codices 1578 and 1624 they are called bishops; it gives them no see, so no `office` is recorded. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
